description: This file defines the MessageControl class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It includes class declarations, nested classes, interfaces, and method signatures related to message control functionalities such as threading, callbacks, configuration, and remote connection notifications. The file sets up the structure for a plugin that manages messaging, WebSocket communication, and remote connection events in a plugin-based architecture.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class implementing message control functionalities, including threading, remote connection notifications, configuration, and message dispatching within the plugin architecture.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: A nested thread class responsible for dispatching messages in a separate thread context.

classes.name: ICollect
classes.description: Interface for message collection with callback registration.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class holding settings for message control, including network nodes and output options.

classes.name: NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents a network node configuration with NodeId, port, and binding information.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications and message observation, managing attach/detach states and dispatching connection events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel to the message control.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel from the message control.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements or messages based on identifier or ID.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Dispatches a message to all interested outputs and WebSocket exporter.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for message collection.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of temporary files related to message dispatching.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message types for specific categories and modules.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Provides an iterator over message control settings.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Fetches and processes messages from the message client.
